discipline.deferred: The check is postponed: this server already had 3 new connections in the last minute, the next one is possible in {{seconds}} s (more would make the network freeze the server for about 2 minutes)
discipline.liveDeferred: Requests through the server left out: {{count}}. Its connection limit for this minute is used up (more would make the network freeze it)

verdict.healthy: The server works: more than 64 KB passed through it
verdict.frozen: Frozen: after the first ~16 KB the data stops without the connection being reset. The network throttles traffic to this server's hosting
verdict.stalled: The data stopped in the middle of the download: the connection is up, but traffic does not pass
verdict.handshakeFailed: TCP connects, but the TLS / REALITY handshake fails: the fingerprint, the REALITY settings or the server version probably do not match
verdict.keyRejected: The server rejected the key: it is outdated or wrong. Refresh the subscription
verdict.ipBanned: The server's IP address is blocked on this network: ping passes, TCP and UDP do not. Changing the port or the transport will not help
verdict.udpBlocked: UDP (QUIC, Hysteria, TUIC) is blocked on this network, TCP to the server passes
verdict.deferred: Not checked: the connection limit for this server is used up for this minute, the check comes later
verdict.notVerified: Not verified: the results do not point to a cause

reaction.tryAnotherFingerprint: Try another TLS fingerprint (chrome or firefox) or the other engine
reaction.preferTcpTransport: Choose a server with a TCP transport (VLESS, Trojan)
reaction.retryLater: Try again in a couple of minutes
